Length constant is artificial: L=10 fixed by design isolates novelty from length guaranteeing R2_length 0.00; C4 is best-case isolation test, follow-up must co-vary length

Single family bias: one catalog family only, no diversity across WebArena types; two-family replication is follow-up work
Bootstrap CI degenerate: rho 1.0 gives CI [1.0,1.0] informative as perfect monotonic but uninformative width (ceiling effect of deterministic proxy, not high precision); disclosed
